title: Occupancy and Residency Certification: First-Contact Offset Measured From the Facility Admission
content:
When a facility-confirmed contact is numbered on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile, the **first-contact offset** taken away from the day count compares the borrower's facility admission date with the profile's absence start date:

| Facility admission date | First-contact offset |
|---|---|
| falls after the absence start date by no more than 30 calendar days (the absence began with a hospital stay and the facility made its first contact soon after the transfer) | 30 days |
| falls after the absence start date by more than 30 calendar days | 60 days |
| falls on or before the absence start date | the plan's interval between contacts during a health-care absence — 90 calendar days under every plan |

The borrower's facility admission date is the date stated on the accepted health-care absence notice on file for the primary borrower received most recently; where none is on file, the profile's absence start date stands in for it. Where the profile carries no absence start date, the handling date stands in for that.

*Boundaries (hypothetical).* Admission 30 days after the absence start date gives 30 days; 31 days after gives 60 days; admission on the absence start date itself gives 90 days.
